Problem Statement:
✨ Allow using dependables with `functools.partial()`

Discussion: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/9744

Using `functools.partial()` with dependables feels like a very obvious idiom. `partial()` already works for dependables that are plain function, but it doesn't work consistently, partial of async and callable classes didn't work consistently.

This PR makes partial() work consistently in all combinations.

turns.reply: The root cause is that `_unwrapped_call` only applies `inspect.unwrap`, which doesn't look through `functools.partial`. So the sync/async/generator checks run against the partial object itself and get the wrong answer. I'll unwrap partials too.

        # functools.partial objects are not unwrapped by inspect.unwrap
        while isinstance(unwrapped, functools.partial):
            unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(unwrapped.func)
        return unwrapped
